comment: Nuxt's generated app config includes ../tests/nuxt/**/* only, but this repo's tests live in tests/{unit,e2e,eval,setup} - so before this project existed vue-tsc typechecked zero test files. `include` replaces rather than merges when extending, so Nuxt's own entries are restated here: without .nuxt/nuxt.d.ts every auto-import in src/ reads as an undefined global.
